header: Cover and clearances behind every booking
subheadline: Nothing on this row has to be requested before a load moves; it applies to the standard consignment note. The insurance figure is per consignment rather than per year, and the customs status covers 11 crossings on the eastern lanes.

badge_items.label: AEO-F customs status
badge_items.description_text: Trusted-trader clearance at 11 border crossings, averaging 41 minutes per bonded load.

badge_items.label: Cargo insured to EUR 1.2 m
badge_items.description_text: Cover applies per consignment, with claims settled in a median of 9 days.

badge_items.label: GDP-compliant cold chain
badge_items.description_text: Load space logged every 4 minutes between 2 and 8 °C, records kept for 5 years.
